plain.li: [feeling:Homesick] I keep listening for the sounds of the place I left.
[feeling:Homesick] Everything here is a little wrong, the way new places are.
[feeling:Homesick,newcomer] I keep reaching for things I left behind.
[feeling:Homesick,newcomer] I don't know anyone's habits yet, and nobody knows mine.
[feeling:Homesick,newcomer] They're kind here, it just isn't home yet.
[feeling:Homesick,newcomer,night] A new bed and new noises, and no sleep to speak of.
[feeling:Homesick,newcomer,eating] It's good food, it's just not the food I grew up on.
[feeling:Homesick,newcomer,working] I'm still learning how they like things done here.
[feeling:Homesick,lowtech] I miss the smell of the fires back home.
[feeling:Homesick,tribal] The land I was born on would know my name.
[feeling:Homesick,medieval] I'd give a lot for one more market day back home.
[feeling:Homesick,industrial] I keep thinking about the streets I grew up on.
[feeling:Homesick,spacer] I keep looking up, as if home were somewhere I could see.
[feeling:Homesick,rain] Rain like this always made home smell good.
[feeling:Homesick,winter] Winter always makes me think of home.
[feeling:Homesick,outside] The sky looks different from here, I swear it does.
[feeling:Homesick,old] At my age you carry home with you, and it gets heavy.
[feeling:Homesick,child] I miss my old bed.
[feeling:Homesick,teen] Nobody here knows the songs I know.

warm.li: [feeling:Homesick] I hope they're all well, back where I came from.

cheerful.li: [feeling:Homesick] Homesick, but I'll be fine once I've found the best seat at supper.

gloomy.li: [feeling:Homesick] Some days I'd give anything to be back where I started.

plain.li: [newcomer] I'm still new here, so tell me how people see {TOPIC}.
[newcomer] Can I ask you about {TOPIC}, while I'm still finding my way?
[newcomer] Everyone here seems to have a view on {TOPIC} already.
[newcomer] Where I come from, we'd have had a lot to say about {TOPIC}.
[agree,newcomer] I've not been here long, but I'd say the same.
[agree,newcomer] Good, that's how we saw it where I come from too.
[debate,newcomer] I'm still learning how things work here, but I'm not sure about that.
[debate,newcomer] Back where I lived, we'd have argued that one all night.
[debate,newcomer] Give me a few more days here, and I'll tell you if you're right.
[argue,newcomer] I'm new here, not stupid.
[argue,newcomer] I've hardly unpacked, and you're already telling me how it is.
[debate,newcomer,tribal] Where I'm from, the elders would have something to say about that.
[debate,newcomer,medieval] In the town I came from, that would have been settled on market day.
[debate,newcomer,industrial] Where I'm from, there'd be a committee for that.
[debate,newcomer,spacer] Where I come from, there'd be a protocol for that.
[agree,newcomer] Good, I'm glad somebody here sees it the way I do.
[debate,newcomer] I'll think it over, I'm still finding my feet here.
[argue,newcomer] Fine, I'll keep my opinions to myself until I've been here longer.
[agree,newcomer] Glad to hear it, I'm still learning the ways here.
[debate,newcomer] We'll see, I'm still learning.
[argue,newcomer] And I thought this would be a friendly place.
[for,newcolony] {SUBJECT} came to a colony that's hardly begun, and hasn't complained once.
[for,newcolony] We need every pair of hands this early on, and {SUBJECT} has two good ones.
[against,newcolony] We've barely a roof up, and now there's {SUBJECT} to feed as well.
[against,newcolony] A new place draws all sorts, and I don't know yet what sort {SUBJECT} is.
[mixed,newcolony] We're all new to this place, really, {SUBJECT} just more than most.
[mixed,newcolony] {SUBJECT} is about as new here as the place itself.
[agree,for,newcolony] A colony this young needs everyone it can get.
[agree,against,newcolony] This place is too new to carry anyone who won't pull their weight.
[agree,mixed,newcolony] We'll learn them the way we're learning this place, slowly.
[debate,for,newcolony] We're all strangers to this place yet, them no more than us.
[debate,against,newcolony] Everyone's welcome while there's building to do, it's after that I worry.
[argue,for,newcolony] We came out here to build something, and we can't do it alone.
[argue,against,newcolony] You'd let anyone in, and this place can't afford mistakes yet.
[agree,for] Let's make sure they've got a proper bed, then.
[agree,against] We'll keep watch on them together, then.
[agree,mixed] We'll make up our minds when we know them better.
[debate,for] Give them a week and you'll see what I see.
[debate,against] Fine, but I'm not lending them my tools yet.
[debate,mixed] Let's ask them to sit with us at supper and see.
[argue,for] I'll show them round myself, then, since you won't.
[argue,against] Don't say I didn't warn you about them.
[argue,mixed] I'm not arguing about someone I've barely met.
[agree] They'll settle in, most do.
[debate] We'll know them better by the end of the season.
[argue] Talk to them yourself before you judge.
[agree,newcolony] Let's give them a part in building it, then.
[debate,newcolony] We'll know them once the first season here is done.
[argue,newcolony] There's too much to build here to fight over one newcomer.

warm.li: [agree,for] I'll see they've got everything they need.

cold.li: [debate] Their first season will tell us enough.
